card.name: The word sooner after "no"
card.fires_on: The word "sooner" in the phrase "no sooner than", when a minimum waiting time is given before resuming, restarting or repeating a treatment step.

modes.label: Minimum wait before resuming
modes.description: "no sooner than" sets the earliest time to resume or restart a drug or method after surgery, a prior dose, or childbirth.
modes.example: Resume CYRAMZA no<< sooner>> than 2 weeks after surgery and until

modes.label: Minimum dose interval
modes.description: "no sooner than" sets the shortest allowed gap between repeat doses or dose increases.
modes.example: Increase dosage by 0.5 mg at intervals of no<< sooner>> than 2-weeks as tolerated to

card.plain: It marks the phrase "no sooner than" that sets the earliest time something can be restarted or repeated.
